name: The Bridge To One
summary:
Bridge To One is an immersive XR narrative experience that places you in the space between possible futures. In this 12-minute journey, you witness three paths humanity could take in the age of advanced AI: escalating conflict, deep social division, or a cooperative abundant future rooted in shared intelligence, restored nature, and global alignment.
